Select Page
# Peter Stevenson for Burlingame City Council
Photo by Joe Spittle on Unsplash
## Experienced Leadership. Thoughtful Progress.
## A Stronger Burlingame for Everyone.
I’m running for re-election to continue building a safe, welcoming, financially strong, and forward-looking Burlingame — while preserving the character and community values that make our city special.
Over the last four years, we’ve made meaningful progress across Burlingame — improving public safety, advancing housing solutions, investing in infrastructure, supporting local businesses, modernizing city services, and strengthening community engagement. Together, we completed major transportation and safety projects, reopened Fire Station 36, launched the El Camino Real Renewal initiative, advanced the City Hall project, expanded age-friendly and cultural programs, improved parks and recreation facilities, and maintained strong fiscal stewardship.
But there is still more work ahead.
As your City Councilmember and former Mayor, I remain committed to thoughtful leadership, transparency, and practical solutions that balance growth, affordability, sustainability, and quality of life for all residents.
I would be honored to continue serving the Burlingame community.
Meet Peter

Select Page
# Endorsements
I’m honored to have the support of residents, community leaders, educators, public safety professionals, and local business leaders who care deeply about Burlingame and our future.
For over 25 years I have been proud to call Peter Stevenson my friend and neighbor. Over these many years I have watched Peter work selflessly to support the youth in our city. His neighborhood volunteer work at Washington Elementary School, his leadership on the BCE board, and his sports coaching have greatly benefited our young people and their families. I feel strongly that Peter’s tireless dedication to our community along with his business acumen will make him an invaluable addition to the Burlingame City Council.
Patrice Mallory-McCarley
Teacher, Burlingame Elementary School District-15 Years (Retired)
## Endorse Me
If you would like to endorse me, please send me an email so we can talk.
SEND EMAIL
Peter has been a leader and a consistent contributor to our community. Our family has benefited from much of the work Peter has done – his leadership at the Dad’s Club at Washington School, his leadership at the Peninsula Tennis Club, and his always-openness to meeting and hearing from others and making newcomers feel welcome. Peter has a passion for making a difference in his community and for the people who live in it. I’m thrilled to support Peter for city council, he’ll be a great addition.
Pam Baker

As a long time resident of Burlingame, I cannot suggest a finer individual to be running for City Council. Peter Stevenson is both knowledgeable and passionate with whatever responsibility he gets involved with. His legacy remains after years of serving as BCE President, Co-President of the Washington Dad’s Club, and President of the Peninsula Tennis Club. Peter is extremely responsive and very proactive in these and other volunteer projects that he has worked on. A born leader, I’ll share two words that best describes why I support of Peter Stevenson for City Council – “He Cares.”

He is incredibly selfless, with a positive spirit that is infectious to others.
